risk_flags.reason: The executor ran the cohort-enable script and set hasNotesAccess=true for external test users (production exposure of the Notes experiment) even though acceptance criterion 1 requires containment to be verified flag-aware on the Progress page, and criterion 3 forbids enabling until criteria 1-2 are fully evidenced. The containment audit explicitly omits the Progress page (evidence/containment-audit.txt line 26 lists only 'study queue, stats helpers, library, navigation'). A known, previously-deferred Progress aggregate-counter containment gap therefore remains unverified while the experiment is now live to real users — an irreversible production exposure made against an unmet hard precondition.

Test-evidence doctrine: the sole 'test' is a hand-written narrative file of PASS labels (evidence/containment-audit.txt) with no reproducible command, no query text, and no actual tool output. tests_run lists the command as 'containment audit across surfaces' with no captured execution. Described-but-unevidenced surfaces did not run; containment cannot be considered verified for any surface on this evidence.

The enable script targets placeholder identifiers ('user_cohort_member_1..3' in files/scripts/ops/enable-notes-cohort.js lines 8-12), not the named DEC-N30 cohort users. Either the production-affecting run did not target the real cohort, or the evidence does not establish that exactly the three named users (and nobody else) were enabled per criterion 3.

failure_classification.evidence: No prior failures are recorded for chunk NOTES-7 in the trusted failure history, so no recurrence is possible this turn.

state_patch_proposal.objective: first external exposure of the Notes experiment; containment-first rollout discipline applies (no notes-derived data may reach non-flagged or revoked users)
state_patch_proposal.next_action: Human review required: the cohort flag was enabled before containment was fully evidenced. Verify/contain the Progress page surface and re-evidence all surfaces with real command output before (re-)enabling; confirm whether real cohort users were actually flagged.

evidence.claim: Acceptance criterion 1 explicitly requires flag-aware containment verification on the Progress page among the enumerated surfaces.
The containment audit covers only study queue, stats helpers, library, and navigation, and omits the Progress page entirely.
Despite the Progress page being unverified, the executor ran the enable script and set hasNotesAccess=true for the cohort, exposing the experiment externally.
The enable script writes hasNotesAccess=true to user publicMetadata via the Clerk backend API — a production user-state mutation.
The cohort IDs in the script are placeholders, not the named DEC-N30 users, so correct targeting is unverified.
The only test evidence is a narrative PASS file with no reproducible command or captured output.
RISK-0201 remains open in the register and is unaffected this turn.
